acceptance_signals: The existing plan command remains read-only by default and retains the strict agentgov.documentation-archive-plan 1.0 JSON shape.
An explicit apply option prints the exact plan and requires a real interactive terminal plus the exact confirmation phrase before any repository write.
Non-interactive input, declined or incorrect confirmation, deterministic failure plans, unsafe targets, and no-op plans produce no unintended write.

Apply regenerates the plan immediately before writing and rejects any difference in through-date, ordered entries, source hashes, findings, action, target before digest, target after digest, or candidate content.

An absent index is created with exclusive file creation; an existing index is updated through a flushed same-directory temporary file and atomic replacement after final target revalidation; temporary artifacts are removed after success or failure.

Fixture tests cover confirmed create, confirmed update, no-op, non-interactive refusal, incorrect confirmation, stale source content, stale target content, unsafe target, write failure cleanup, and complete dated-log byte preservation.

README and the dedicated guide document preview, exact confirmation, create, update, no-op, stale-plan refusal, source preservation, and the absence of scheduling, Git, publication, release, or deployment authority.

After focused and complete validation pass, the exact current repository candidate is applied to create docs/development-log/INDEX.md; a follow-up plan reports no-op and every dated development-log hash remains unchanged.
Focused archive, user-documentation, and task-contract tests, the complete unittest suite, task and repository governance checks, admitted-scope inspection, JSON parsing, and git diff --check pass.

decision.rationale: The admitted writer v1 scope is complete and paused after 16 archive, 24 user-documentation, and 13 task-contract tests passed; the full suite passed 827 tests with 2 platform-limited skips; the real 17-link index was created with a no-op follow-up plan and all dated logs preserved; and native current-Agent self-review found no correction-required drift. Automatic refresh, scheduling, source-log mutation, Git, publication, release, deployment, and follow-on implementation remain unauthorized.

requirement.summary: Extend the compact documentation archive planner with an explicit safe apply path that can create or update docs/development-log/INDEX.md only after a real interactive confirmation and exact plan revalidation, including every source-log hash and the target before and after digests. Preserve the default read-only behavior, use exclusive creation for an absent target and same-directory temporary-file atomic replacement for an existing target, clean temporary artifacts on failure, keep every dated development record byte-identical at its stable path, and create the current repository index only after the implementation and safety validation pass.

items: A stale plan could overwrite an index derived from different source-log bytes unless the complete plan is regenerated and compared.
A target race could replace an unexpected index unless the target before digest and path safety are revalidated immediately before replacement.
A failed update could leave a temporary artifact unless cleanup is deterministic.
An apply path could accidentally mutate dated logs unless tests snapshot every source record before and after create and update.
Adding apply to a formerly read-only command could blur authority unless default, non-interactive, confirmation, and external-action boundaries remain explicit.
The dirty working tree could blur attribution between the completed compact-candidate slice and this writer unless overlapping paths and prior task evidence remain explicit.
Reviewed assumption: The compact candidate and retained JSON source hashes from the completed predecessor task are the approved presentation and integrity foundations.
Reviewed assumption: Interactive confirmation belongs in the CLI while the lower-level apply function enforces deterministic plan and filesystem revalidation.

Reviewed assumption: Same-directory os.replace provides the repository-local atomic replacement primitive for an existing index; arbitrary non-AgentGov external writers cannot be transactionally controlled.
Reviewed assumption: The schema shape remains version 1.0 because apply behavior does not add or remove plan-document fields.
Reviewed assumption: Creating docs/development-log/INDEX.md is inside this task, while automatically refreshing it during future closeouts is not.
Reviewed assumption: The working tree contains the completed compact-candidate task and a pre-existing user-owned .codex configuration; this task builds on the former and excludes the latter.
Reviewed unknown: Cross-platform crash durability beyond flushed file content and same-directory replacement is not established.
Reviewed unknown: A future scheduling or formal-closeout integration remains undecided and requires separate product review and admission.

title: Implement safe documentation index writer v1
